DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 紛失の申し出についてのご相談ですね。その後、カードは見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice about your loss report. Has the card been found since then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上着の別のポケットから見つかりました。さっき紛失の連絡をしたので、もう使えない状態なのか、まだ使えるのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別ポケットでカードを発見したが紛失連絡後の利用状態が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found it in another jacket pocket. I reported it lost a little earlier, so do not know whether it is now unusable or still usable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found the card in another pocket but do not know its usage status after reporting loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し出の記録とカードの状態を確認する必要があります。見つかったからといって、すぐに使用を再開しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the report record and card status. Do not immediately resume using it just because it was found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 機械に入れて試すのはやめます。紛失を伝えたときの受付番号は控えていますが、カード番号を口で読んだほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械で試さず、受付番号を控えておりカード番号を口で読む必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not try it in a machine. I noted the loss report's reference number, but should I read the card number aloud?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will not test it in a machine, have the report reference and ask whether to read the card number aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今は受付番号を確認します。暗証番号などは口頭でお伝えにならず、個人情報の確認は担当の案内に沿ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: For now we will check the reference number. Do not say your PIN or similar information aloud; follow staff guidance for personal-information checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付番号だけを示します。停止を取り消せると思って来たのですが、再利用の条件はまだわからないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号だけを示し、停止取消や再利用の条件は未確定と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will show only the reference number. I came thinking the suspension could be canceled, but conditions for reuse are not known yet, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show only the reference number and confirm cancellation of suspension and reuse conditions are not yet determined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、担当が状態を調べてご案内します。再発行が必要な場合にも、費用や受け取れる時期は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, staff will examine the status and explain. If reissue is necessary, costs and when it can be received are checked separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず状態と再利用の可否を聞きたいです。再発行が必要とわかった場合だけ、その費用と受取時期も説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: まず状態と再利用可否を尋ね、再発行必要時にだけ費用と時期を説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want the status and whether reuse is possible. Only if reissue is found necessary, please also explain its cost and receipt timing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask first about status and reuse, and request cost and timing explanations only if reissue is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順で確認します。ここでカードが見つかったと伺っただけで、停止が解除されたり再発行の申込が済んだりするわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check in that order. Hearing here that the card was found does not itself lift suspension or complete a reissue application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかったと知らせるだけでは手続き完了ではないのですね。試しに使わず、受付番号と現物を用意して担当の確認を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見報告だけでは完了でなく、試用せず受付番号と現物で担当確認を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: So simply reporting it found does not complete procedures. I will not test it, but prepare the reference number and card for staff checks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say a found-card report alone is not completion, and you will not test it but undergo staff checks with reference number and actual card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では紛失の受付番号から照会します。見つかったカードはお手元に置き、担当の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will inquire using the loss-report reference. Keep the found card with you and await staff guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 買い物袋の持ち手についてのご相談ですね。二枚とも同じ状態でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about shopping-bag handles. Are both bags in the same condition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週買った二枚組のうち、一枚だけ持ち手の縫い目がほつれています。一度使ってから気づいたので、開封前からかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚組の一枚が使用一回後にほつれ、開封前からか不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Of the two-pack bought last week, just one has a fraying handle seam. I noticed after using it once, so do not know whether it was there before opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain one of a two-pack frayed after one use, with its condition before opening unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ気づいたかも含めて確認します。商品と、購入したことがわかるものを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check including when you noticed. May we see the product and something proving purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋二枚とレシートを持っています。レシートには別の日用品もありますが、この「袋セット」の行が購入分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚とレシートを示し、ほかの商品でなく袋セットの行が購入記録と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both bags and the receipt. Other household items are on the receipt too, but this bag-set line records the purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show both bags and receipt and say the bag-set line, not other products, is the purchase record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その行と商品を照合します。使ったときの状況や、その後に補修したかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will match that line and the product. Tell us the circumstances of use and whether you repaired it afterward too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本を入れて持ちましたが、重さは量っていません。ほつれに気づいてからは使わず、自分で縫い直してもいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本を入れたが重量不明で、発見後は使わず縫い直しもしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I carried books in it but did not weigh them. Since noticing fraying I have not used it or sewn it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it carried books but weight is unknown, and you have neither used nor resewn it after discovery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重さは不明で補修していない、と伺います。原因はまだ決められませんが、ご希望の対応はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Weight unknown and no repair, understood. The cause cannot yet be decided, but is there an outcome you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず交換を相談したいです。ただ、二枚組なので一枚だけでよいのか、セット全体の確認が必要なのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換を相談し、一枚単位かセット全体の確認が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: First I want to discuss exchange. But as it is a two-pack, I also want to know whether one bag suffices or the entire set needs checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss exchange and ask whether checks are by individual bag or the whole set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認する範囲と対応条件を担当に尋ねます。交換できると今ここでお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask staff about the checking scope and handling conditions. We cannot promise exchange here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも確認してもらえるよう、レシートと一緒に出します。交換できない場合も、理由と次に相談できる方法を説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚と購入記録を出し、交換不可の場合も理由と次の相談方法の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will submit both with the receipt so they can check both. If exchange is impossible, please explain why and how I can consult next too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit both bags and purchase record, and request reasons and next consultation options even if exchange is impossible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では二枚の状態と購入記録を確認します。いただいたご希望を担当へ伝えますので、結果の説明をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check both bags' condition and purchase record. We will tell staff your wishes, so wait for an explanation of the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池への道をお探しですか。この案内図では、入口から下る道が短い経路になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking for the pond route? This map shows the downhill path from the entrance as the short route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 短いなら歩けそうだと思ったのですが、帰りは上りになるのですね。今日は坂を上る負担を少なくしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池へ短い下りでも帰りは上りと理解し、今日は上りの負担を減らしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought a short route might be walkable, but it will be uphill returning, right? Today I want less uphill effort.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show understanding that even a short downhill pond route means uphill return, and say you want to reduce climbing effort today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ道で戻ると上りになります。距離だけでなく帰りの負担もありますので、上の花壇付近を歩く候補もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Returning by the same path means uphill. Besides distance there is return effort, so walking around the upper flower beds is another option.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池まで行くことにはこだわりません。花壇のほうなら途中で休み、坂を下りずに入口へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池にはこだわらず、花壇で休んで坂を下りず入口へ戻れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not fixed on reaching the pond. If I choose the flower beds, can I rest partway and return to the entrance without going downhill?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the pond is not essential, and ask whether you can rest by the flower beds and return to the entrance without descending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図では花壇とこの入口は同じ高さの道でつながっています。花壇の先の分岐からは下りになるので、そこへは進まない形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the map the flower beds and this entrance connect by a level path. Beyond the flower-bed fork it descends, so do not go there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分岐を越えず花壇で折り返します。休む場所は日なたばかりでしょうか。少し日陰で座れると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 下り分岐を越えず花壇で折り返すと伝え、日陰で座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will turn back at the flower beds without crossing the fork. Are rest places all sunny? Sitting in a little shade would help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will turn at the flower beds before the downhill fork, and ask about shaded seating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 屋根付きの休憩場所が花壇の手前にあります。ただ、席が空いているかまでは今はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a roofed rest area before the flower beds. But we do not currently know whether seats are free.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 座れると決めつけず、空いていなければ長く待たず入口へ戻ります。花壇へ向かう道の色を図で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席を前提とせず満席なら待たず戻ると伝え、花壇行きの線の色を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume a seat; if full I will return to the entrance without waiting long. Show me the flower-bed path's color on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not depend on seating and will return without waiting if full, and ask the flower-bed line's color. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 花壇への道は緑の線です。池へ下る道は青ですので、分岐で色だけでなく行き先の文字も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The flower-bed path is green. Down to the pond is blue, so at the fork check destination words as well as colors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 緑の線と「花壇」の表示を確かめ、青い池の道には入りません。休めないときは花壇まで行かず、手前から戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 緑線と花壇表示を照合し青い池道へ入らず、休めなければ手前から戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the green line and flower-beds sign and not enter the blue pond route. If unable to rest, I will return before reaching the flower beds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will match green line and flower-bed signage, avoid blue pond route and turn back early if unable to rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では緑の往復路と屋根の場所に印を付けます。池への短さにこだわらず、その日の負担に合わせて途中でお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46220-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will mark the green return route and roof location. Rather than focus on the pond's short distance, turn back partway according to that day's effort.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この切符の案内をご覧ですね。今日行きたい場所はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at this ticket's guidance. Have you decided where to go today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの駅で降りたいです。「乗り放題」なら、このメモの二駅へ両方行けると思って選びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二駅で降りる予定で、乗り放題なら両方へ行けると思って案内を選んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to get off at two stations. I chose the guidance thinking unlimited rides meant I could go to both stations in this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you plan to stop at two stations and selected the guidance thinking unlimited rides meant both were covered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗り放題でも、この図の対象範囲を確認する必要があります。最初の駅はこちらですが、二つ目は線の外側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even unlimited rides require checking this map's coverage. The first station is here, but the second is outside the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 何度乗れるかだけでなく、どこまで使えるかが違うのですね。範囲外へ行く費用も足すと、別の切符のほうが合うか比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 範囲外の駅があると理解し、追加費用を含む総額を別の切符と比べたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So not only how often you ride, but how far it applies differs. Including the cost outside the area, I want to compare whether another ticket suits better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand a station is outside coverage and ask to compare total including extra cost with another ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つ目へ行く場合の必要な切符を調べ、合計で比較しましょう。帰る日は今日で変わりありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check tickets needed for the second and compare totals. Is your return still today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日帰ります。ただ、二つ目は時間があれば行く程度です。そこをやめて最初の一駅だけにする場合も、料金を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日日帰りだが二駅目は任意なので、最初の一駅だけの場合も料金比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, today. But the second is only if time allows. I also want prices if I skip it and only visit the first station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is a day trip but the second station is optional, so you also want fare comparisons for only the first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一駅だけの場合と二駅の場合を分けます。この券で乗れる列車の条件も、この欄で確認してからお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will separate one-station and two-station cases. Check conditions for trains usable with this ticket in this field before choosing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一駅だけに絞る方向で考えます。「範囲内なら列車の種類も全部同じ条件」とは思わず、乗りたい列車と合うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一駅に絞る方向と述べ、範囲内でもすべての列車で同条件と思わず希望列車の適合を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am leaning toward only one station today. Without assuming every train has the same conditions within the area, I want to ask whether my desired train fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you lean toward one station and want suitability of your train checked, without assuming all train types have identical conditions within the area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の列車をこの画面で示していただければ、必要な切符を確認します。まだお支払いは進めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show your preferred train on this screen and we can check needed tickets. Payment has not proceeded yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この列車です。一駅だけの日帰りとして必要な切符と合計を確認し、乗り放題という名前だけでは買わないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望列車を示し、一駅日帰りの必要券と合計を確認して名称だけで買わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: This train. I will check needed tickets and total for a one-station day trip and not buy solely from the name unlimited rides.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your train and decide to check tickets and total for a one-station day trip, not buy by the name alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一駅の日帰りと、この列車についてのご相談として控えました。範囲と列車の条件を分けて、発売の案内へ進みます。こちらでご一緒にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I noted a one-station day trip and this train as your questions. We will separate area and train conditions and proceed to sales guidance. Please check together here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談ですね。どの文を確認なさりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice on a notice. Which sentence do you want checked?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この条件には自分は当てはまらないと思い、何もしなくてよいと考えていました。でも、この小さい文字が気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分は条件に該当しないと思い何もしないつもりだったが、小さい文字の指示を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought these conditions did not apply to me and planned to do nothing. But this small print concerns me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought yourself ineligible and planned no action, but want to check the small-print instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここには「該当しない場合もご連絡ください」とあります。対象に当てはまるかの判断と、連絡が必要かは分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It says please contact us even if not applicable. Let us separately check applicability and whether contact is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 対象外と思ったことだけで、返信しなくてよいとは言えないのですね。実は同封の返信用紙を捨ててしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象外でも返信不要とは言えないと理解し、返信用紙を既に捨てたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So thinking I am outside the scope does not mean no reply is needed. Actually I already threw away the enclosed reply form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show understanding that being outside scope does not mean no reply, and report already discarding the reply form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その事情も担当へ伝えましょう。通知自体に件名と連絡先、対応の日付は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell staff that too. Does the notice itself retain the subject, contact and action date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、通知と封筒はあります。この日付が連絡の期限なのか、用紙を送る期限なのか、私には区別できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知と封筒は残るが日付が連絡期限か用紙送付期限か不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have the notice and envelope. I cannot tell whether this date is the contact deadline or the deadline to send the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain notice and envelope remain, but it is unclear whether the date is for contact or sending the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの対応の期限かも含めて、担当へ照会しましょう。対象外だと思った理由を、短く説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask staff including what action the deadline refers to. Can you briefly explain why you thought yourself inapplicable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内には同居人についての条件があり、私は一人暮らしなので当てはまらないと思いました。その考え方が合うかも確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居人についての条件に対し一人暮らしだから対象外と思った理由を述べ、その判断も確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The guide has conditions about cohabitants, and I live alone, so thought it did not apply. Please check whether that interpretation is right too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain thinking cohabitant conditions did not apply because you live alone, and ask to check that judgment too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 件名、そう考えた理由、返信用紙を処分したこと、日付の意味を順にお伝えください。用紙の代わりに何で連絡できるかも尋ねましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell staff the subject, your reason, disposal of the reply form and meaning of the date in order. Ask how to contact instead without the form too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その四点と、用紙がない場合の連絡方法をメモしました。期限が延びるとは思わず、通知を手元に置いて担当へすぐ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 件名・理由・用紙処分・日付と代替連絡方法を控え、延長を前提にせず通知を手元に担当へ相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted those four and the contact method without a form. I will not assume an extension, but keep the notice with me and consult staff immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note subject, reason, form disposal, date and alternative contact, and decide to consult with the notice without assuming extension. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談内容が整理できましたね。通知を持ってこちらの担当席へどうぞ。対象の確認と返信方法の質問を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The questions are organized. Take the notice to this staff desk. We will pass on applicability and reply-method questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらへのご来院は初めてですか。受付にお出しになる物を、いったん見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: First visit here? Could you show what you will present at reception first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。この診察券を持ってきましたが、前に住んでいた所の病院の物です。それで受付できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: こちらは初診だが旧居の病院の診察券で受付できると思って持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought this patient card, but it belongs to a hospital where I used to live. I thought it could be used for reception here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain this is your first visit here but you brought the old area's hospital card thinking it would work for reception. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは別の施設の診察券ですね。こちらの受付について確認します。今日は、どのような症状で来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is another facility's card. We will check reception here. What symptoms brought you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三日前から腕に赤い所があって、かゆいです。昨日、自分で買った塗り薬を使いましたが、薬の名前は袋で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 腕の赤みとかゆみは三日前からで、昨日使った購入薬の名称は袋で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: A red itchy area on my arm for three days. Yesterday I used ointment I bought myself, but want to check the name on its bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say arm redness and itching began three days ago, and you want to check the purchased medicine's name on the bag after using it yesterday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状が始まった日と、薬を使った日を分けて問診に書いてください。確認書類や薬の袋もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write symptom onset and medicine-use dates separately on the questionnaire. Have you brought identification documents and the medicine bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認書類と袋はあります。薬を使ったのは昨日で、赤くなり始めたのは三日前、と別々に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認書類と薬袋を提示し、薬使用は昨日・症状開始は三日前と分けて記入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both documents and bag. I will write separately that medicine use was yesterday and redness began three days ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show ID documents and medicine bag and say you will distinguish yesterday's medicine use from symptoms starting three days ago. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の記載も診療担当へ伝えます。薬を続けるかどうかは診察で相談してください。初診の記入で迷っている所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell clinical staff the bag's wording too. Ask during examination whether to continue the medicine. Any confusing first-visit form fields?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前かかった病院の欄です。今日初めてという意味と、今まで一度も病院に行っていないという意味を混ぜたくありません。どのように分けて書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: こちらへの初診と病院未受診を混同しないため、以前の病院欄の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The previous-hospital field. I do not want to confuse first time here with never having visited any hospital. How should I write them separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the previous-hospital field's meaning to avoid confusing first visit here with no hospital visits ever. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへの来院歴と、ほかの施設の受診歴は分けてお知らせください。わからない箇所は、そのまま質問していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell us visits here separately from history at other facilities. Ask directly about unclear sections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらは初診で、前の病院には通ったことがあると書きます。症状と薬の袋、確認書類を出し、足りない物は受付で教えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: こちらは初診・他院の受診歴ありと記し、症状・薬袋・確認書類を出して不足物を教えてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write first visit here and previous visits to the other hospital. I will present symptoms, medicine bag and ID, and want reception to tell me anything missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write first visit here but prior other-hospital history, and say you will give symptoms, medicine bag and ID and ask about missing items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診とお持ちの物を確認する担当へつなぎます。別施設の診察券はお返ししますね。診療へのご案内まで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will connect you to staff checking questionnaire and belongings. I will return the other facility's patient card. Wait here until clinical guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの封筒ですね。どこで見つけた物か教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are handing in an envelope. Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝、通路で拾いました。少し厚みがあるのでお金かと思いましたが、開けていないので中身はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝通路で拾った封筒は厚みから金銭と思っただけで未開封・中身不明と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This morning in a passage. It is a little thick so I thought money, but it is unopened and I do not know the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a morning passage find, only guessing money from thickness, with unopened unknown contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 推測と確認できたことを分けて伺います。何時ごろ、通路のどのあたりでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish guesses from confirmed facts. Around what time and which part of the passage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 八時ごろです。建物の入口を出た外側で、掲示板のすぐ下にありました。店の中で見つけたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 八時ごろ建物入口外の掲示板下で発見し、店内ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around eight. Outside after the building entrance, right under the noticeboard. Not found inside a shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain finding around eight under the noticeboard outside the building entrance, not inside a shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外の掲示板の下ですね。封筒には、拾ったときから封がされていましたか。誰かへ中身を確かめてもらいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Under the outside noticeboard, then. Was the envelope sealed when found? Did you have anyone check contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封は最初から閉じていました。ほかの人にも開けてもらわず、このまま持ってきました。表に宛名も見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初から封は閉じ、他人にも開けてもらわず、見える宛名もないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was closed from the beginning. I had no one open it and brought it as it was. I cannot see an addressee on the front either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was sealed from the start, nobody opened it and there is no visible addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見える状態も記録します。持って来るまでの間に、落とした方だという人から話しかけられたりはしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record its visible condition too. Before bringing it, did anyone claiming to be its owner speak to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、誰からも声はかけられていません。拾った後は家へ寄り、封筒をかばんに入れたまま、こちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち主を名乗る人から声はかからず、一度帰宅後もかばんに入れたまま窓口へ来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No one spoke to me. After finding it I stopped home, then came here keeping it in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain nobody claiming ownership spoke to you, and after returning home once you kept it in your bag and came to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経路も含めて控えます。今の説明に違いがないか、この記録の場所と時刻をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will note that route too. Check the recorded location and time for any difference from your explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八時ごろ、入口の外の掲示板下で合っています。中身を現金と書かず、未開封で不明と記録してください。この封筒をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻と場所を照合し、中身は現金と断定せず未開封不明と記録してもらい封筒を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around eight under the noticeboard outside the entrance is right. Do not write contents as cash; record unopened and unknown. Here is the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match time and place, request unopened unknown contents rather than definite cash, and hand over the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未開封で中身不明として、封筒を受け取りました。今後の確認事項は続けてご説明します。ここまでの状況を丁寧にお伝えいただき、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We received the envelope as unopened, contents unknown. We will continue explaining future checks. Thank you for carefully describing events so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越しに関する相談ですね。以前のお申込みがある場合は、その内容から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Advice about moving, then. If you applied before, we will start with that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二か月前に一度引っ越して転送を申し込み、今週また引っ越しました。前々の家宛ての郵便も、自動で今の家へ来ると思ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二か月前の転送申込み後に今週も転居し、前々の家宛てが自動で現住所へ来るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved two months ago and applied for forwarding, then moved again this week. Can I assume mail to the home before last will automatically reach my current home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether after forwarding two months ago and another move this week, mail to the home before last automatically reaches the current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前の受付内容と、今回必要な手続きを担当へ確認しましょう。前のお申込みの控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check previous acceptance and procedures now needed with staff. Have you kept the previous application's copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。この控えは前々の家から前の家への分です。今の家の住所は、まだここには書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧控えは前々の家から前の家への申込みで、現住所が載っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. This is from the home before last to the previous home. My current address is not written here yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the old copy applies from the home before last to the last home and does not show the current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを整理しましょう。三つの住所と、実際に移った日がわかるメモも用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us organize that difference. Could you also prepare notes of three addresses and actual moving dates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 前々の家、前の家、今の家の順に書きます。同じ建物名が二か所あるので、部屋番号まで省かずに並べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三住所と移動日を順に整理し、同名建物が二か所あるため部屋番号まで省かず書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write the home before last, previous and current in order. Two have the same building name, so I want to list without omitting room numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize three addresses and moving dates in order, and say you will include room numbers because two building names match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所を取り違えないために、そのように分けてください。これだけで転送が全部つながるとは判断せず、担当の回答を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate them that way to avoid address mix-ups. Do not decide this alone links all forwarding; get staff's answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申込済みの区間と、今回まだ頼んでいない所を分けて聞きます。今すぐ受け取りたい通知の差出人にも、今の住所を直接知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込済みと未申込を区別し、急ぐ通知の差出人へも現住所を直接知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask separately about the applied-for section and what I have not requested now. I also want to directly tell the sender of an urgent notice my current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish applied-for and unapplied parts, and say you will directly tell the urgent-notice sender your current address too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大事な通知の差出人への連絡も、郵便の申込みとは別に進められます。窓口では受付状態と、今回の確認書類や申込方法をお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Contacting important notice senders can proceed separately from postal applications. Ask the counter about acceptance status, identification for this time and application methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い控えと三住所のメモを持って担当へ相談します。自動で今の家へ届くとは決めつけず、今回の受付がどうなったかも確認して控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い控えと三住所のメモで担当へ相談し、自動転送を前提にせず今回受付の状態も控えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult with the old copy and three-address notes. I will not assume automatic forwarding to my current home, but also check and note this application's acceptance status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult staff with old copy and three-address notes, not assume automatic forwarding and record current acceptance status too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、前の控えはこのままお持ちください。二度の転居と確認事項を担当へ伝えました。こちらの席でお話をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the previous copy with you. I told staff about both moves and checks. Please continue at this desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご住所の登録に関するご相談ですね。口座についてのご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This concerns your registered address. Is it about an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の住所は先日変更しましたが、このカードの通知は前の住所でした。名前が似ているので、一緒に変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座住所は変更したが似た名称のカード通知は旧住所で、一括変更と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed the account address the other day, but this card's notice had the previous address. The names are similar so I thought they changed together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the account address changed but a similarly named card notice had the old address, and you thought changes were combined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座とカードで手続きの窓口が同じか、まず確認しましょう。口座の変更控えと、カードの案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First check whether account and card procedures use the same counter. Do you have the account-change copy and card guidance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。口座の控えだけを見て全部終わったと言っていたので、カードのほうも済んだかは別に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座変更控えとカード案内を提示し、カードの変更完了は別に確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both. I said everything was finished based only on the account copy, so want to separately check whether the card is done too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show account-change copy and card guidance, and say you want separate confirmation of card completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このカードの案内にある運営元と問い合わせ先を確認して、担当できる範囲をご説明します。通知のどの点が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the operator and contact in the card guide and explain what we can handle. Which part of the notice concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先が前の住所で、部屋番号も古いままです。通知を出した時点が住所変更より前かどうかも、まだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知封筒は旧住所・旧部屋番号だが、発送時点と変更日との前後は未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The envelope destination is the old address, and room number remains old. I have not checked whether dispatch was before the address change either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the envelope has old address and room number, but dispatch timing relative to the change is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の発送時点と、現在の登録先は分けて照会しましょう。いまの登録が古いと、この封筒だけで断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us inquire separately about dispatch timing and current registration. This envelope alone cannot prove the current registration is old.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い封筒を見て登録も古いと決めないのですね。カードの現登録と、次の通知先を聞き、手続き先が別なら自分でそちらへ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い封筒だけで現登録も古いと断定せず、現登録と次通知先を尋ね窓口が別ならそちらへ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should not decide current registration is old from an old envelope. I will ask current card registration and next notice destination, and consult the other office myself if procedures are separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not conclude current registration is old from the envelope alone; ask current registration and next destination, and say you will consult the other counter if separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認事項をまとめましょう。個人情報があるので、案内と控えは周囲に見えないようお手元でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us summarize those checks. Because there is personal information, keep guidance and copies with you out of others' view.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座変更の控えとカード通知を別にして、運営元、現登録、今後の通知先を聞きます。一括で変わったと思わず、必要な申込みを確認してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二書類を分け、運営元・現登録・今後通知先を聞き、一括変更と考えず必要申込みを確認後に進めると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate the account-change copy and card notice and ask operator, current registration and future destination. Without assuming combined change, I will confirm necessary applications before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the two documents, ask operator, current registration and future destination, and decide to confirm necessary applications without assuming combined changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご質問を担当へ引き継ぎました。二種類の書類をご自身でお持ちになり、こちらへどうぞ。口座とカードの担当範囲からご案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your questions are passed to staff. Keep both document types yourself and come here. Receive guidance starting with the account and card responsibilities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのスープをご覧ですか。原材料の欄は袋の裏にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Looking at this soup? Ingredients are on the back of the packet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: きのこの写真なので、野菜だけのスープだと思いました。肉を使わない物を選びたいのですが、裏も確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: きのこ写真から野菜のみと思ったが、肉不使用を希望するため裏面の原材料を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The mushroom photo made me think it was vegetable-only. I want something without meat, so want to check the back too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the mushroom photo suggested vegetables only, but because you want meat-free you want to check back ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この袋の原材料には鶏肉エキスと書かれています。写真に写った具だけで判断しないで、原材料をお読みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This packet's ingredients say chicken extract. Read ingredients rather than judging only from pictured pieces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 具に肉の形がなくても、エキスが入っているのですね。この商品は選ばず、別の袋の原材料も自分で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉の形がなくても鶏肉エキス入りと理解し、この品を選ばず他の袋も原材料を見たいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So even without meat-shaped pieces it contains extract. I will not choose this and want to read another packet's ingredients myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand chicken extract can be present without meat pieces, reject this product and say you want to inspect other ingredients too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示はこちらです。読めない原材料がある場合は、製造元への問い合わせ先も確認できます。ご不明な言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The label is here. If an ingredient cannot be read, manufacturer contact is available too. Any unfamiliar words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の袋には、材料名なのか調味料名なのかわからない語があります。わからないまま肉不使用とは決めないで、名前を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別袋に意味不明の語があり肉不使用と断定せず語を控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Another packet has a word I cannot tell is an ingredient or seasoning name. Without knowing, I will not decide it is meat-free and will note the word.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say another packet has an unclear word, and you will note it without concluding meat-free. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その商品について確認してからお選びください。保存方法も、この二つで同じとは限りません。どのように使うご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Choose after checking that product. Storage may differ between these two too. How do you intend to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一人で少しずつ使うつもりでした。でも、二食入りというだけで開封後も同じように置けると思わず、開けた後の表示も知りたいです。
